text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet meeting chaired by President Ben Ali recommends speeding up the restructuring of agriculture.
- President Ben Ali receives report from chairman of the high committee of administrative and financial control Habib Belhaj Said on the activities of the committee in 1996.
- President recommends speeding up of the modernisation of public adminstration management.
- French vessel Foudre is to put into port in Tunisia for five days from July 11-15 in the framework of French National day and the place of Tunis as regional cultural capital in 1997.
